PS2:the-fairly-oddparents-shadow-showdow.d: The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown is a 2004 platforming video game released for Microsoft Windows, GameCube, PlayStation 2, and Game Boy Advance by THQ. ImaginEngine developed the PC version, Blitz Games developed the console versions, and Helixe developed the Game Boy Advance version. The game is based on the animated series The Fairly OddParents and is the sequel to The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' Da Rules. A version for the Xbox was announced, but never released. Shadow Showdown follows series protagonist Timmy Turner and his Fairy Godparents as they attempt to recover the stolen Royal Jewel, the source of fairy magic, so they can fix Timmy's TV in time to watch a show he has…

PS5:tropico-7.d: Tropico 7 is an upcoming construction, management and government simulation video game developed by Gaming Minds Studios and published by Kalypso Media. It is set to be the seventh installment in the Tropico series. The game is scheduled to be released on PlayStation 5, Windows, Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S on 28 January 2027.

NES:thexder.d: Thexder (テグザー, Teguzā) is a run and gun video game from Game Arts, originally released for the NEC PC-8801 in 1985. It was ported to many systems, including the Famicom, MSX, Apple II, and MS-DOS. It was a commercial success, selling over one million units worldwide.

WiiU:mario-and-luigi-superstar-saga.d: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga is a 2003 role-playing video game developed by AlphaDream and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance. It is the first game in the Mario & Luigi series. The story follows Mario and Luigi as they travel to the Beanbean Kingdom in order to combat Cackletta and Fawful, who stole Princess Peach's voice for the purpose of harnessing the power of a special artifact called the Beanstar. Superstar Saga is the third role-playing game in the Mario franchise, following Super Mario RPG (1996) and Paper Mario (2000), and features a lighthearted, whimsical script with a greater emphasis on comedy than earlier titles.

PC:dragon-fin-soup.d: Dragon Fin Soup is a role-playing video game created by the independent development studio Grimm Bros. It is the studio's first title and was released on Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, and PlayStation Vita. It is influenced by roguelike games and uses procedural generation. The game has two modes: Story mode follows a story and is more like a typical role-playing game, while Survival mode skips the story and focuses on the surviving within the game and constrains players with permadeath—once the player character dies, the game must be restarted from the beginning.
